articles.title: No Breakthrough in Iran Talks as Red Lines Remain Firm
articles.summary: New information has emerged regarding President Trump's recent meeting in the Situation Room, where he requested several edits to a deal negotiated between his envoys and the Iranian regime. Bloomberg News White House Correspondent Jeff Mason and Bloomberg's UAE bureau chief Dana Khraiche joined David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend to analyze the complexity of the ongoing negotiations. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: 由于红线仍然坚定，伊朗谈判没有突破
